english.title: Use pipe or apparatus which has been attached or altered without consent of appropriate agency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the appropriate agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), used

(A)_[a pipe]_
(B)_[apparatus]_

which had been

(C)_[attached]_
(D)_[altered]_

in contravention of section 176 of the Water Resources Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 176(3)(b) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In proceedings against a person for this offence, it shall be a defence for that person to show that he did not know, and had no grounds for suspecting, that the pipe or apparatus in question had been attached or altered as mentioned - section 176(4)
